player_prompt.intro:
Sika'y Managpapat {player_id} ed JoJoJoin, pinalnan ed board ya 5x5 ya walay selula ya numerado 0-24.
No panag-pano mo, itayak mo so tanda mo ed anggan selula ya aliwa, alimbawa '[12]'.
SIKA SO NANGABAK ed paggawa na APAT ya tanda mo ed pila — apat ya konsikusong selula ed pahigda, patayo, o diagonal.
A bilang Managpapat {player_id} sika'y '{symbol}'; so kalaban mo ya '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Say inyakar ya sulat et aliwan unong ed dugan pormat.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} aliwan valid cell. Nepeg ya walad baetan na 0 tan 24.

game_action.placed: Managpapat {player_id} inyaplikar so tanda to ({symbol}) ed selula {cell}.
